name: Wicker's Vigil
summary: The cult has raised a wicker effigy on the highest hill north of Wickermoor and needs thirteen souls to burn in it. Adela is the last piece; the night is one long road across the moor to Rowan's Rise.

stages.journal: The Crooked House is down, and every freed spirit in it is streaming north over the moor toward a bonfire on the hill.
stages.hint: Go north up the moor road, out of the village.

stages.journal: The storm at the moor's edge has a face in it, and the face is grinning at us.
stages.hint: Talk to whoever is left at the edge, then cross the heath.

stages.journal: Boneflayers have come out of the smoke over the heath, and they are taking villagers.
stages.hint: Fight on the heath, or walk on.

stages.journal: In the quagmire six villagers stand sunk to the waist and the mud is moving.
stages.hint: Pull the villagers out of the bog.

stages.journal: On the hardpan, four of the Foxwillow folk sat down and put out shoots.
The cult's stone circle: nine stones, six captives, a ring of fire waiting for a signal.
stages.hint: Bring down four of the nine stones, then the cult.

stages.journal: The ring is down. Above it the Wicker Man stands with Adela in its chest.
We fell back to Wickermoor. The effigy will come for the village at full power.
objectives: Destroy the Wicker Man in the village
stages.hint: Make your stand in the Round.

stages.journal: The Wicker Man is down, a column of sparks. In the ash something crooked crawled, and fell still.
The Wicker Man is ash, and Adela with it. Phillip knelt in the ash and left to bury her. The Crooked Man is gone too.
We did not stand. The Wicker Man walked down from Rowan's Rise and burned Wickermoor to the ground.
